about: Title-update edit of globalsoundinfo.drm (sound DTP PC 792 / Xbox 775: 3 new sound groups for DLC 2) against the player's PC original, learned by tools/globalsoundinfo_build.py learn from the Xbox retail <-> TitleUpdate.000 pair. Offsets are bytes in the PC section before the edit (set_u32, inserts.at) or in the result (new_internal); values are word values as the Xbox reads them; entry set words carry the PC byte form of their field proven on the base entries ([offset, value, form, proof]). Only tu_literal_bytes bytes are TU values; entries are copies of PC entries. not_taken = the other TU changes of the file (left out, as by the B138 kit). kit_form_words = set words the kit wrote in another form (default build = kit).

inserts.what: sound group entries 77..79 (0x84 each): copy of a PC entry + set words

set: base entries: 2 of 77 distinguish u32 / u16x2; u32 contradicted by [58, 59], u16x2 by none
base entries: 2 of 77 distinguish u32 / u16x2; u32 contradicted by [58, 59], u16x2 by none

inserts.what: runtime area (+0x80 pointer target) of new group 79: zero bytes
runtime area (+0x80 pointer target) of new group 77 and the following new group(s): TU u32 words

learn_notes: PC DTP 792 and retail DTP 775: same size 13920, relocations equal (94 internal)
PC = u32-swapped retail in 3470 of 3480 words (others at 0x28, 0x2c, 0x38, 0xb8, 0xd8, 0x158, 0x168, 0x170, 0x1fd8, 0x205c)

kit_form_words.why: the engine reads the group entry field +0x7c as a u16 (0x58de54 cmp word ptr [eax+0x7c], 0; 0x587620 movzx = DSP kind 1..11 -> FMOD DSP type, 0x7b98ea) and the base entries 58 / 59 carry it as u16 halves (retail 00050000 -> PC 05000000); the B138 kit file has these words u32-swapped (00000400 / 00000100: u16 at +0x7c = 0, no DSP for the new groups). Default build = kit bytes (md5 gate), --tu-form = base-rule form
